2610.06623.title: Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes
2610.06623.paper_summary: Building on our earlier program-evolution workflow guided by large language models (LLMs), we study weight-five bivariate bicycle (BB) and perturbed bivariate bicycle (PBB) codes. The resulting catalogue contains 1,142 distinct code proposals, including 1,081 nonbaseline proposals attributable to LLM-generated programs. Across the catalogue, we certify connected Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) realizations [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], and [[180,4,14]]. A post-search comparison certifies seven imported Lin--Pryadko archive constructions. For leading parameter triples also represented in that archive, we provide exact distance evidence, explicit bivariate presentations, and verified component reductions. A basis-independent connectivity analysis identifies 409 of the 1,142 catalogue entries as disconnected and shows that 73.1\% of the classes with exact distance certificates contain repeated connected components. Algebraic analysis organizes the connected CSS classes into order-3, order-7, and order-15 cyclotomic-kernel strata. The strongest exact connected PBB parameter point is [[216,4,10]], attained by two distinct component classes. Among the 936 distinct CSS proposals from the LLM-guided campaign with a recorded positive distance, 816 (87.18\%) are certified at $d\geq5$. For comparison, three random-search controls each sample 6,444 CSS code proposals uniformly without replacement, using the same per-lattice and encoded-dimension sample counts as the LLM-guided campaign. In these controls, 4,672--4,785 proposals (72.50--74.26\%) meet the same criterion. The LLM-guided campaign has the higher certified yield, while the random controls cover more connected classes. Together, these results extend LLM-guided discovery to a more constrained code family and provide a reproducible structural and exact-distance account of its strongest candidates.
2610.06623.paper_summary_zh: 基於我們早期由大型語言模型（LLMs）指導的程式演化工作流程，我們研究了五權雙變量自行車（BB）和擾動雙變量自行車（PBB）碼。所產生的目錄包含1,142個不同的碼提案，其中1,081個非基線提案歸因於LLM生成的程式。在這個目錄中，我們認證了連通的Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) 實現 [[96,4,10]], [[140,6,10]], 和 [[180,4,14]]。一次後搜索比較認證了七個引入的Lin--Pryadko檔案建構。對於在該檔案中也有表示的主要參數三元組，我們提供了精確的距離證據、明確的雙變量呈現和驗證的組件簡化。一個基於基礎無關的連通性分析確定了1,142個目錄條目中有409個是斷開的，並顯示73.1\%的具有精確距離證書的類別包含重複的連通組件。代數分析將連通的CSS類別組織為三階、七階和十五階的圓根核層級。最強的精確連通PBB參數點是[[216,4,10]]，由兩個不同的組件類別達成。在936個來自LLM指導活動的具有記錄的正距離的不同CSS提案中，816個（87.18\%）在$d\geq5$時被認證。作為比較，三個隨機搜索控制各自均勻地抽樣6,444個CSS碼提案，且不重複，使用與LLM指導活動相同的每個晶格和編碼維度樣本數。在這些控制中，4,672--4,785個提案（72.50--74.26\%）符合相同標準。LLM指導活動的認證產量較高，而隨機控制涵蓋了更多的連通類別。總體而言，這些結果將LLM指導的發現擴展到更受限的碼族，並提供了其最強候選者的可重複結構和精確距離的說明。
2610.06623.author: Juan Cruz-Benito et.al.
